boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 133 arranges numbered key blocks on the arms of a T-shaped board, with a center `13` spine and a bottom blast grid. Directional arrows on the blue downward block and green right-strip mark the only legal exits. The top-left magenta `7` alcove must clear before the tall blue `1` stack can shift — otherwise it blocks the center spine's only drainage path.
landmarks: Block Out Level 133 arranges numbered key blocks on the arms of a T-shaped board, with a center `13` spine and a bottom blast grid.
Directional arrows on the blue downward block and green right-strip mark the only legal exits.
The top-left magenta `7` alcove must clear before the tall blue `1` stack can shift — otherwise it blocks the center spine's only drainage path.

quickTips: Keep the green left bar intact while clearing the bottom blast grid.
Save the 1/10 pair until the 9 tile unlocks on the bottom flare.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Pop the top cyan 24 and 21 tiles plus the left/right arm 17 and 19 blocks before the center 13 column drops.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Clear the bottom colored grid from the green left bar outward, keeping the 1/10 pair sealed for the final gate.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Break the center 13 spine once both arm alcoves empty, feeding the 18 side tile into the waist.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Slide the blue downward-arrow block through the narrow corridor after the counters shrink to 12.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Detonate the green right-arrow cluster on the bottom flare once the 9 tile unlocks.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Spend the bottom 0/1 counters and exit the last magenta and blue scraps for the board clear.

failurePoints: Dropping the center 13 spine before the arm alcoves empty, sealing the waist.
Moving the green right-arrow cluster before the 9 tile unlocks, trapping the 0/1 gate.
